sections.sectionText: Amazon Advertising Certification and Global Overview Campaign Course - This industry immersion course is a partnership with Global Overview designed to provide students with an experiential learning opportunity relevant to building careers in advertising, marketing, media and related fields. Part One introduces students to an array of terminology, techniques, strategies, processes and practices related to a variety of advertising campaign solutions, with an emphasis on e-commerce. Students who successfully complete part one will receive professional certification from Amazon Advertising. Part Two will allow students to develop, pitch and implement a comprehensive campaign for real-world clients in collaboration with Faculty and Global Overview executives. Students who successfully complete both parts of the course will receive 3 hours of academic credit. Meets with ADV 392 AMZ (76385).

AI in Advertising: Industry Views & Practical Applications: This 1-credit seminar-style course explores how artificial intelligence is actively reshaping the advertising industry. Through live, virtual conversations with industry professionals, students will learn how AI tools are being used to conduct research and mine insights, support creative development, plan and optimize media, personalize messaging at scale, forecast performance outcomes, and manage brand visibility in answer engines. This class complements existing advertising coursework by grounding AI in real-world practice rather than theory alone.

sections.sectionText: Meets with ADV 461 (71918) This class will survey the emerging landscape of computational advertising. It will provide students with a thorough understanding of the technologies including web-search, auctions, behavioral targeting, and mechanisms for viral marketing that underpin the display of advertisements on a variety of locations. These locations include web pages (banner ads), on prominent search engines (text ads), on social media platforms, as well as cell phones. The students shall also learn about new research areas in computational advertising including electronic billboards, moving objects (banners atop taxi cabs) and algorithmic synthesis of personalized advertisements. This class will also discuss issues related to consumer privacy.
